title: Replace DateTime.now() wall-clock calls with DateTimeFactory.nowUtc() in profile_creation_use_case_test.dart
why: TQ-6 requires hermetic tests with no wall-clock; check 6/15 of make audit already forbids DateTime.now() in lib/ (outside core/time) but doesn't scan test/, so this slipped through. This same file's own setUp (line 37-38) correctly uses DateTimeFactory.nowUtc() — these 4 calls (lines 226, 227, 277, 278) are the only wall-clock use in the file, seeding LearnerProfilesCompanion.insert rows directly. Currently harmless since no assertion reads the timestamp, but it's an inconsistent, uncontrolled precedent in an otherwise clock-disciplined test file.
acceptance_criteria: The repo-wide DateTime.now() Rule-0 grep is extended to cover test/ (TQ-6 checker)
